title: Axis of Fate
next_chapter_hook: That vague name on the Axis of Fate—is it merely coincidence or the inevitability of karma? The truth behind Chen Ling's disappearance might be more brutal than he imagined...

text.content: Night inked the sky, and along the ancient road outside Tianqing Sect City, a cold figure stood motionless. Cang Yutian gazed at the silent Sect Gate, a playful curve forming at the corner of his lips, as if everything was under his control. Yet at that very moment, in a secret chamber within the city, the Turtle Shell divine artifact in Chen Ji's hands suddenly emitted a low hum. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: 'It's here... The one who gazes upon the Axis of Fate—you must connect with that ancient will before he finds you!' Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his fingertips forming seals at lightning speed, and the patterns on the Turtle Shell's surface began to flow eerily, as if something ancient was awakening.

The formations on all four walls of the secret chamber roared to life. Chen Ji sat cross-legged, cradling the Turtle Shell divine artifact in his palm. This Turtle Shell was an ancient relic Mo Xiansheng had awakened from deep slumber, said to possess the ability to communicate with the most forbidden realms within the Tianji Record. Now, under Chen Ji's deliberate guidance, the patterns on the Turtle Shell's surface began resonating with the Void, and streaks of subtle light seeped out, slowly weaving into a translucent, axis-like shadow. 'So this is the Axis of Fate...' Chen Ji murmured, his pupils reflecting the gradually forming axis image, an indescribable sense of awe welling inside him. The axis figure appeared both primitive and desolate, seemingly laden with countless cycles of karmic consequence across ages, with each point of light representing a divergent thread of destiny.

dialogue.content: 'Young man, don't stare for too long!' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly surged with intense fluctuation, his voice carrying an unusual hint of urgency. 'The Axis of Fate embodies the concrete manifestation of Heavenly Dao's will, and each glimpse exacts a price! Your Heavenly Fate Value is nearly depleted. If you continue forcing yourself to witness...' Chen Ji remained oblivious, his eyes firmly fixed on that axis shadow. Within the dense web of fate's silk threads, he glimpsed his own name—a point of light ensnared by countless chains, so dim it seemed on the verge of extinguishment forever. Beside that glowing point, a line of blurred characters loomed, the prophecy of his death he'd learned seven hundred chapters prior. Yet now, with this prophecy revealed so starkly, an unprecedented chill crawled through Chen Ji's heart.

text.content: 'Not merely a death prophecy...' Chen Ji's voice dropped low and hoarse. He perceived far more. At that juncture of fate, two distinctly different silk threads extended from his name—one leading to death, the other toward an uncharted chaos. What chilled him more was the source of these two threads, twisted around two opposing forces: one cold and intimately familiar, unmistakably Cang Yutian's aura; the other vast and boundless, icily indifferent to all living beings, bearing the unique imprint of Heavenly Dao's Eye. 'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji abruptly comprehended, chuckling bitterly. 'The seven-hundred-chapter death prophecy was never a Heavenly Dao's judgment—it's your joint creation!'

dialogue.content: At this moment, from the depths of that axis shadow, a frigid voice suddenly resonated, like a Nine Nether cold wind brushing past the soul: 'Interesting... Someone actually managed to glimpse this layer.' Chen Ji's entire body trembled. That voice didn't emanate from any direction but directly echoed within his consciousness, as if the Heavenly Dao itself conversed with him. 'Insignificant chess piece, you've seen what you shouldn't have.' The voice continued, devoid of any emotional fluctuation. 'But what you've witnessed is merely the tip of the iceberg, a fragment of what the Axis of Fate reveals. If you seek the complete truth, you must pay the corresponding price—Are you willing?' Chen Ji clenched his teeth, aware of what kind of entity he faced. The Heavenly Dao's Eye represented the ultimate will transcending all Sects and mortals, while he was merely a trivial piece on its chessboard.

choice.prompt: Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice echoed in Chen Ji's consciousness as he faced a critical choice: exchange his remaining Heavenly Fate Value for truth, or seek alternative paths.

choices.text: Pay the price to glimpse the truth
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to go all in, using his remaining Heavenly Fate Value to obtain the complete revelation of the Axis of Fate. Although it might plunge him into greater peril, only by surveying the entire landscape could he strategize.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete truth of the death prophecy
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value exhaustion may trigger unknown consequences

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, his eyes flashing with resolute determination. 'Since I've come, there's no turning back.' He raised the Turtle Shell divine artifact high, silently chanting the ancient incantation Mo Xiansheng had taught him. In an instant, the patterns on the Turtle Shell's surface erupted with dazzling golden light. A crimson drop of essence blood slowly seeped from Chen Ji's Brow Center—each droplet embodying his covenant with the Heavenly Dao, the tangible manifestation of his Heavenly Fate Value. Golden light intertwined with the Axis of Fate's illusory shadow, causing the entire secret chamber to become enveloped by a formidable will. Chen Ji felt himself suspended within an endless cosmic sea, countless silk threads of destiny howling past him. At the horizon of this starry expanse, those cold, emotionless eyes quietly observed him.

choices.text: Refuse and question the other party
choices.description: Chen Ji chose not to passively accept. He would engage with Heavenly Dao's Eye in the posture of a chess player, questioning its true intentions.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the other party
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Dao's Eye may strike directly

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a cold laugh, withdrawing his hand from the Axis of Fate: 'A price? Heavenly Dao's Eye, we both know this is merely your usual trick.' His voice remained unusually calm, yet carried an unmistakable edge. 'You deliberately positioned Cang Yutian outside Tianqing Sect City, then orchestrated my perception of the Axis of Fate at this precise moment—this is indeed a trap, isn't it?' Chen Ji stared directly at those invisible eyes, speaking each word with deliberate precision. 'I'm most curious—why would a Heavenly Dao's will, accustomed to manipulating all chess pieces, personally intervene to guide a mere mortal?'

choices.text: Let Mo Xiansheng negotiate on his behalf
choices.description: Chen Ji took a step back, allowing the guardian Mo Xiansheng to engage Heavenly Dao's Eye in dialogue as an ancient inheritor, perhaps obtaining a different form of treatment.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be threatened as a result

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately respond to the cold inquiry, but said in a deep voice: "Mo Xiansheng, how much do you know about the Shaft of Destiny?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, then slowly said: "It is the source of the Tianji Record, and also the channel through which the Heavenly Will monitors the fate of all beings. Every holder of the Tianji Record must eventually have some degree of contact with it..." Chen Ji interrupted him: "Then you shall dialogue with it." Mo Xiansheng was slightly taken aback, then let out a bitter laugh: "You rascal, you certainly know how to order people around." But he still gathered his thoughts and spirit, speaking in an ancient and solemn tone: "Will of the Shaft of Destiny, please allow an ancient inheritor to pose a question to you."

The ethereal projection of the Shaft of Destiny trembled slightly, and that cold voice rang out again, but with an imperceptible hint of interest: "Chen Xuan's inheritor... Interesting, it has been long since a chess piece dared to take the initiative to speak with me." Mo Xiansheng's voice was steady and respectful: "Great Will, my inheritor wishes to know whether the death prophecy seven hundred chapters ago was a just judgment of the Heavenly Dao, or the private arrangement of two individuals?" The air seemed to freeze for an instant, that voice fell silent for a moment before slowly saying: "Since you wish to see, I shall let you see clearly." The words fell, and the ethereal projection of the Shaft of Destiny suddenly expanded, countless threads of fate flowing rapidly before Chen Ji's eyes, finally converging into a clear image—a dark secret chamber, Cang Yutian kneeling on one knee, and before him, a massive eye gazing down with cold indifference.

"I need a chess piece to balance the Heavenly Dao structure that is about to lose equilibrium." The voice of the Heavenly Eye came from the image. "You need an opportunity to take revenge on the Tianji Record inheritor who rejected you." Cang Yutian kept his head lowered, his voice carrying irrepressible hatred: "Yes, great Will. As long as you help me break through my current bottleneck, I am willing to become your blade." The Heavenly Eye was silent for a moment, then said: "I shall cast the Tianji Record Fragment onto a mortal, and you will become his 'calamity'. When he grows to a certain stage, you will personally end his fate—in exchange, I will grant you what you desire." Chen Ji watched this cross-temporal secret pact, and the last trace of侥幸 in his heart was completely shattered. From the very beginning, he was the chosen sacrificial offering, and his so-called defying heaven and changing destiny was merely a pre-arranged drama in the eyes of the Heavenly Eye and Cang Yutian.

dialogue.content: "Now you know." The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again, but with a playful tone. "But this is not all. Do you think that breaking your shackles and reversing your fate will grant you freedom?" Chen Ji猛地抬头, only to hear that voice continue: "Engraved on the Shaft of Destiny is not only your death prophecy, but also another choice—if you forcibly break the shackles, seven shackles will simultaneously shatter, and at that time, the entire order of the Heavenly Dao will descend into chaos. The three major sects will collapse in an instant, the Demonic Path will pour out in full force, the seal of the Ancient Forbidden Land will completely break... And your so-called relatives and friends will all turn to ashes in this catastrophe." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and he finally understood the truly terrifying nature of this chess game—not that he could not resist, but that the price of his resistance was the entire world.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye revealed a cruel truth: Chen Ji's freedom was tied to the survival of the entire world. He had to make a choice.

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Will and Cang Yutian are both enemies, there is no room for compromise. Chen Ji decided to break through fate with the strongest posture, even if it triggered the collapse of the Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_cost: The risk of the Heavenly Dao order collapsing
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from the shackles of fate
choices.risk_hint: The butterfly effect that might lead to the destruction of the world

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter echoing in the secret chamber, carrying a hint of madness and unruliness: "What a fine Heavenly Dao order, what a fine living beings of the world!" He abruptly stood up, his eyes burning with unprecedented fire. "You used my life as a bargaining chip, used the entire world as stakes, yet still expect me to乖乖 submit?" He said each word with emphasis. "Since this Heavenly Dao wishes to collapse, then let it collapse! Since this fate wishes to be destroyed, then let it be destroyed! Even if Chen Ji is smashed to pieces, I will never be the鱼肉 on your砧板!" The Turtle Shell artifact in his palm trembled violently, as if sensing its master's determination, the patterns on its surface beginning to burn wildly.

choices.description: Chen Ji never believed in either-or choices. The Heavenly Eye said breaking the shackles would cause order to collapse, so there must be a third path—he would use strategy to find it.
choices.visible_cost: Need more time to lay out plans
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian will not give him much time

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the fire in his heart. The corner of his mouth lifted into a cold smile, one forged through countless desperate situations. "Heavenly Eye, you underestimate me too much." He spoke slowly, his voice terrifyingly calm. "You only told me that breaking the shackles would cause order to collapse, but did not say I cannot find a third path." He began pacing in the secret chamber, his mind racing through all the information. "What Cang Yutian wants is revenge and breakthrough, what you need is balance—and what I want is simply a future that allows me to protect those I wish to protect. The three parties' interests are not entirely in conflict, so there must be a point of equilibrium."

choices.description: Acting hastily only leads into a trap. Chen Ji decided to endure for the time being, continuing to act as atrash persona, secretly searching for the true method to break the局.
choices.risk_hint: Might be struck first by Cang Yutian

text.content: Chen Ji's smile slowly faded, replaced by a deeper form of endurance. "I understand." He said softly, as if he had comprehended something in an instant. "Since you want a obedient chess piece, I will continue playing along." He sat back down on the meditation cushion, storing the Turtle Shell artifact into his sleeve, his face donning that mask of cowardice and calm once more. But his mind was racing— the Heavenly Eye thought he had surrendered, Cang Yutian thought he was still thetrash that could be easily manipulated, not knowing that this was precisely his most skilled battlefield. Chen Ji never feared waiting, because what he was best at was weaving an unbreakable chess game in the shadows.

Just at this moment, the ethereal projection of the Shaft of Destiny suddenly trembled violently. Chen Ji looked up in surprise, only to see among the dense threads of fate, a point of light was flickering frantically, its glow entirely different from other points—not bright gold, nor dim gray, but a hazy, blurred white, as if deliberately obscured by some force. "What is that?" Chen Ji下意识地开口询问. The Heavenly Eye's voice was rarely silent for a moment, then said: "You should not have seen that." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, staring fixedly at that blurred point of light. Beside the point of light, two characters' outlines were faintly visible—those two characters were too blurred to distinguish, but Chen Ji always felt they had an inexplicable familiarity, as if they had some flesh-and-blood connection with him.

"Chen Ling..." Chen Ji murmured that name, an indescribable shock surging in his heart. Beside that blurred point of light was engraved precisely the name of his sister who had been missing for years. Chen Ling, that girl taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key", that existence that appeared as a blurred outline in all prophetic visions— she actually had such a profound connection with the Shaft of Destiny? Chen Ji suddenly recalled all the prophetic visions he had seen before, whenever Chen Ling appeared in a vision, it was always blurred and unclear. At that time, he thought it was merely the special ability of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, but now it was clear—someone was deliberately concealing the relationship between Chen Ling and the Shaft of Destiny. "Heavenly Eye," Chen Ji's voice abruptly turned ice-cold, "what exactly is the relationship between my sister and the Shaft of Destiny?"

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a long while, that silence seemingly containing some complex emotions. Finally, it spoke, its voice carrying for the first time a sense of something unfathomable: 'Twin... twins of destiny. Do you think you are merely ordinary siblings?' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, a bone-deep chill rising from his spine. 'Long, long ago,' the Heavenly Eye's voice slowly said, 'two names were carved upon the Axis of Destiny—one representing destruction, the other rebirth. For thousands upon ten thousand years, these names have continuously cycled, and no one has ever been able to break this cycle. And you, Chen Ji, are merely one link in this generation's cycle.' Chen Ji felt as if his heart was being gripped tightly by an invisible hand. Destruction and rebirth... Chen Ling... could it be that he and his sister had been bound to opposite sides of destiny from the very beginning?"

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul violently fluctuated within Chen Ji's mind, his voice carrying unprecedented astonishment: 'This is impossible... the legend of twins, I have only seen fragments in ancient scrolls. According to legend, every pair of twins has some mysterious connection to the Axis of Destiny—one is destined to become the destroyer of destiny, the other the guardian of destiny... but because their fates are too tightly intertwined, any attempt to peer into their relationship causes the prophecy to become blurred!' Chen Ji suddenly understood something. Chen Ling's existence interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight, not because she was the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, but because she herself was part of the Axis of Destiny! They were twins, two extremes bound together by destiny—destruction and rebirth!"

choice.prompt: "The truth struck like thunder, and Chen Ji had to face an unprecedented choice: were he and Chen Ling destined opposites arranged by fate, or was there another possibility?"

choices.text: "Vow to break the curse of the twins"
choices.description: "Chen Ji does not accept destiny's arrangement; he wants to break this tens of millions of years cycle, making twins no longer opposites, but true family."
choices.visible_cost: "May have to pay an enormous price"
choices.visible_reward: "May completely change the landscape of destiny"
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Eye may try to stop him"

text.content: "Chen Ji rose abruptly, his eyes burning with unprecedented determination. 'Destruction and rebirth?' His voice was low and powerful, 'That is your definition, not mine!' He stared directly at the intangible Axis of Destiny, saying word by word, 'Chen Ling is my sister, the only relative I have in this world. No matter how destiny arranges things, no matter how heaven rules, I will not let her become anyone's chess piece!' His voice echoed through the secret chamber, as if declaring war on the entire Heavenly Way, 'Your so-called cycles, your so-called destiny—starting today, I will end them!'"

choices.description: "Now the most important thing is not to struggle against destiny, but to find Chen Ling. Perhaps only by finding her can we understand the truth of all this."
choices.visible_cost: "May expose the intention of searching for Chen Ling"
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Eye may set a trap"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Anger cannot change reality; only by finding Chen Ling can all these mysteries be solved. 'Tell me,' he stared directly at those intangible eyes, his voice calm yet carrying unyielding determination, 'Where is my sister now?' The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a moment, then let out an ambiguous chuckle: 'You are more pragmatic than I imagined. But do you think I would tell you?' Chen Ji did not answer, simply waiting quietly. He knew that with an existence like the Heavenly Eye, sometimes silence itself was an answer—it was hinting that Chen Ling's whereabouts were not within the Heavenly Eye's control, or rather, that someone was even more unwilling than the Heavenly Eye to let him find Chen Ling."

choices.description: "Chen Ji suddenly realized that the Heavenly Eye had voluntarily revealed this information, and there must be a purpose behind it. Rather than passively accepting, he should take the initiative to expose the other party's intentions."
choices.risk_hint: "May fall into an even greater trap"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly let out a cold laugh, interrupting the dissipating phantom of the Axis of Destiny. 'Wait, Heavenly Eye.' His voice carried a hint of mockery, 'You voluntarily telling me all this—surely you aren't really showing off your omniscience?' The Heavenly Eye did not respond, but Chen Ji had already read the meaning within that silence. He continued: 'Cang Yutian is just outside the city, yet you choose this moment to let me peer into the Axis of Destiny, voluntarily revealing these shocking secrets—what exactly do you want me to do?' The secret chamber fell into deathly silence. After a long while, the Heavenly Eye's voice sounded again, carrying an ambiguous tone: 'You are very clever, Chen Ji. Clever enough to surprise me... perhaps it is time to change the game.'"

"The light on the Turtle Shell Artifact's surface slowly faded away, and the phantom of the Axis of Destiny also gradually dissipated in the air. But Chen Ji knew this was merely a beginning. The Heavenly Eye's final words still echoed in his ears: 'Change the game'—this meant that from now on, he would no longer merely passively respond to Cang Yutian's pursuit, but would truly face the Heavenly Will that manipulated everything in direct confrontation. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul slowly coalesced into form, revealing a rare, grave expression: 'Young man, what you saw today has far exceeded my expectations. The twins' destiny, the cycle of destruction and rebirth... these secrets, even the Heavenly Eye itself probably dares not fully control.' Chen Ji stood up, storing the Turtle Shell Artifact into his sleeve, a flash of determination in his eyes: 'Then I will make none of them able to control it.'"

"Just then, a streak of terrifying thunder suddenly tore across the night sky outside the secret chamber, illuminating the entire Tianqing Sect as bright as day. Chen Ji's brow furrowed; he sensed the aura contained within that thunder—it was Cang Yutian's unique demonic path cultivation technique. Chen Ji gazed toward the direction outside the secret chamber, murmuring: 'He came faster than I imagined.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying some urgency: 'Cang Yutian has already arrived outside the city. At his speed, he will reach the sect gate in half an hour at most. You must make a decision quickly—whether to fight, flee, or...' Chen Ji shook his head, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth: 'Neither is urgent.' He sat back down on the meditation cushion, assuming the posture of one deep in cultivation, 'Since he wants to put on a show, I will accompany him to the end. But this time, the script will be written by me.'"

"The lingering resonance of the Axis of Destiny still echoed in Chen Ji's consciousness, those shocking truths branded like brands upon the depths of his soul. Cang Yutian and the Heavenly Eye's secret pact, the true source of the seven hundred chapters of death prophecies, the Heavenly collapse that breaking the shackles would trigger, and that deliberately obscured name—Chen Ling. Each truth was enough to overturn his understanding of this world, yet Chen Ji felt unprecedentedly clearheaded at this moment. He was no longer that waste who passively endured destiny, but a chess player who had seen the entire game board. The Heavenly Eye thought that 'changing the game' could continue to control him, but what it didn't know was that from this moment, the balance of attack and defense had quietly reversed. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting the gradually brightening horizon beyond the window, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth. The chessboard of destiny was already set, and he, was about to become the one who overturned it."
